subject.title: Feature request: session:reset hook event for memory persistence on auto-resets

question: Which automatic reset hook contract should OpenClaw support for daily and idle rollover memory persistence?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the permanent API shape affects internal hooks, typed plugin hooks, and upgrade-visible session behavior, so automation should not choose it alone.

options.title: Refine active PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/61675 as the candidate and require maintainers to accept or revise its command-style daily/idle plus before_reset contract before merge.

options.title: Define typed reset event
options.body: Pause the active PR and specify a new session:reset or session:before-reset lifecycle surface before wiring bundled session-memory to it.

options.title: Use lifecycle hooks only
options.body: Keep automatic rollover on existing session_end/session_start hooks and adapt memory persistence around that contract instead of adding command-style reset actions.

recommendation.title: Refine active PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/61675 as the candidate and require maintainers to accept or revise its command-style daily/idle plus before_reset contract before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest current routing signal from the active candidate branch repair and adjacent hook/session-memory history.
